model: Flowcast's unconditioned simulated Tuesday (buildPopulation + buildSourceDay with 2026-10-27's campus events and the published timetable), then applyIncident fire-drill with the map's default 30 minutes. Deterministic: seeded by hashes of the incident id and agent ids, no Math.random.

choice.building: Charles River classroom location with the most simulated people at 11:00 on the baseline day (2349 of 2817; next: Questrom 1342, CFA 820).
choice.measuredAt: First whole minute after the model's last occupant leaves the building, i.e. when the drilled building first reads empty.
choice.places: The drilled location, then up to 4 other places with a changed head count at measuredAt (day with vs without the drill): other locations in the same footprint first, then by largest absolute change. The assembly point has no capacity and is reported separately.

assembly.name: Modeled outdoor assembly
assembly.note: Modeled point on saved pedestrian geometry outside every footprint; not an official assembly area, capacity unknown.

places.name: Physics and Biology Research Buildings (3-5 Cummington Mall)
